body.name: GaussianHandle
body.def: For fixed finite \((\mathcal E,T)\), \(\alpha_{\rm conf}\), and \(\bar\rho\), start from the shared multiplier empirical process of all affine faces, estimate the max/min directional derivative on a self-normalized near-active face set, and splice in \(\mathcal C_{\rm end}\) whenever a relevant estimated face variance degenerates.
body.role: Starting move for sharper tie-robust inference
